snippet.title: New Game 【Forestrike】First Game play Demo
snippet.description:
【About Forestrike】

Forestrike is a Kung Fu Roguelite about a martial artist embarking on a journey across the country to free the Emperor from an evil general’s influence.

The hero encounters many foes on his path to the capital, and he is always outnumbered, but he has a secret weapon: the Foresight, a meditative technique that allows him to mentally imagine fights over and over until he finds a sequence of movements that allows him to win.

Once ready, our hero must fight in reality, where losing means starting everything over.

Development by Skeleton Crew Studio 
https://www.skeletoncrew.co.jp/index.html
